page.overview:
Who is Fillonce?

Fillonce is an mermaid and one of the Mermaid Cafe Dancers.

Fillonce is a mermaid with a clear blue almost white tail which has an agglomerations of white dot-like markings. And just like Camie, she has prominent lips. Her pink somewhat frizzly hair opens wide with her bangs curling to the right.

She wears a red bikini top, with the straps crossing over the exact top of her cleavage, through a ring, and around her neck.

Like all other mermaids shown so far, Fillonce is friendly, kind, caring, and is apparently fun loving. She even seems to like Sanji like the rest of her friends. Like Ishilly, Fillonce does have a curious side to her, wanting to see what was inside Caribou's tightly sealed barrel.
